newsitem.title: GREECE: STRINTZIS BUYS IONIAN STAR VESSEL FOR $31 MLN.
newsitem.headline: STRINTZIS BUYS IONIAN STAR VESSEL FOR $31 MLN.

text.p: Shipper Strintzis Lines said on Tuesday it acquired the passenger-car ferry Ionian Star from Italy's Viamare for $31.5 million.
The vessel was leased by Strintzis since March 1994 and the acquisition was part of an earlier agreement, it said.
Ionian Star which was built in 1992 has undergone a $10.3 million renovation which brings its total cost to $41.8 million.
"Based on an international evaluator the ship's market value is $53 million giving rise to an unrealised capital gain of $11 million," Strintzis Lines said.
The acquisition of Ionian Star will help Strintzis Lines further strengthens its presence in the Adriatic sea routes where as of October 21 it will operate independently.
Its previous joint venture with Greece's Minoan Lines was terminated, it said.
